intro: Laughing Sisters is a Horde quest that sends mages into the heart of Ashenvale to gather enchanted locks of hair from wild dryads. The material is destined for Kil'hala, an experienced troll tailor at the Crossroads, to spin into an empowered mage robe. Hunting the daughters of Cenarius underscores the relentless friction between Horde spellcasters and the native defenders of the ancient woodland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...
For these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.
When you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, friend. Deino said you would come, and would bring the laughing sisters' hair. Do you have it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this hair will weave into a fine robe, friend. It is a pity the laughing sisters had to die to part with it, though I do doubt they would ever give it willingly.
A pity, but only a small one.
